sources.title: rehan-fal/minimax-h3-360-equirect-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A LoRA for MiniMax H3 that makes the model generate 360° video: the whole sphere around the viewer unwrapped into one equirectangular frame, straight ahead in the centre, directly behind at the left and right edges, with H3's native audio.
